Definition: from G1909 and G714; to avail for, i.e. help:--relieve.
BiblicalUsage: Eparkeo means to relieve, to help in a way that actually meets the need. Paul uses it of the church relieving widows: a widow who has relieved the afflicted is herself to be relieved, and believers should relieve their own widows so the church is not burdened.
TheologicalSignificance: Real relief is practical, not sentimental — it is help that arrives, and the church is meant to carry it.
